'''Toby Geltner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 10th at [[September 2001 Cincinnati tournament]] on 15 September 2001 with Klatooinian, according to Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2964">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggsd2964/ cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggs], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 15 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggsd2964/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
